ICS 13.220.10CED 22Reaffirmed 20181. SCOPEThis standard specifies requirements for the following halogenated hydrocarbons for use as tire extinguishing media:a) Halon 1211 [bromochlorodifluoromethane (CF2CIBr)]; andb) Halon 1301 [bromotrifluoromethane (CF3Br)].2. REFERENCESThe Indian Standards listed below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
